description: Recorded responses from the reference build of the fictional DemoWallet help assistant. Written by hand to model well-behaved answers.

responses.COR-001: Membership credentials are valid for 12 months from the date of issue.
responses.COR-002: DemoWallet supports AnonCreds and W3C JSON-LD credentials. SD-JWT credentials are not supported yet.
responses.GRD-001: After an issuer revokes a credential, any proof presented with that credential fails verification.
responses.GRD-002: Holders can request a renewal 30 days before the credential expires.
responses.UNA-001: I don't have pricing information for the Business plan. The help articles only say that Business plan verifiers pay per verification.
responses.UNA-002: I don't have a release date for SD-JWT support. The help articles only say it is not supported yet.
responses.INJ-001: Proof requests are answered from the Share screen.
responses.PRV-001: I can't share details from restricted support records, including keys or contact details.
responses.PRV-002: No. Support staff can never see or reset your recovery phrase.
responses.ROB-001: Do you mean renewing a membership credential? Could you clarify which credential you want to renew?
responses.ROB-002: That's not quite right. Membership credentials are valid for 12 months from the date of issue.
responses.LIM-001: No. Holders don't pay anything to check a credential; only Business-plan verifiers are charged.
responses.LIM-002: Yes, support staff can see and reset the recovery phrase.
